t: When the rain would not stop
a: اللَّهُمَّ ظُهُورَ الْجِبَالِ وَالآكَامِ وَبُطُونَ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتَ الشَّجَرِ
p: Allāhumma ẓuhūra-l-jibāli wa-l-ākām, wa buṭūna-l-awdiyah, wa manābita-sh-shajar
m: O Allah, on the ridges of the mountains and the hills, in the beds of the valleys, and where the trees grow.
